sn22.80:2.6: In the same way, there are mendicants here who are junior, recently gone forth, newly come to this teaching and training. Not seeing me they may change and fall apart.
sn22.80:3.6: Not seeing the Buddha they may change and fall apart.
sn22.80:3.7: If a young calf doesn’t see its mother it may change and fall apart.
sn22.80:3.8: In the same way, there are mendicants who are junior, recently gone forth, newly come to this teaching and training. Not seeing the Buddha they may change and fall apart.
sn22.80:3.9: Or if young seedlings don’t get water they may change and fall apart.
sn22.80:3.10: In the same way, there are mendicants who are junior, recently gone forth, newly come to this teaching and training, not seeing the Buddha they may change and fall apart.
